description: This file contains unit tests for the StatusInfo class in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.utils.health package. It verifies the behavior of StatusInfo including JSON serialization/deserialization, immutability, equality, status merging, and the composite pattern implementation.

classes.name: StatusInfoTest
classes.description: JUnit test class verifying the behavior of the StatusInfo class, including equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, status merging, and composite logic.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that instances of StatusInfo are immutable and that StatusDetailMessage is also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that equals() and hashCode() methods are implemented correctly for StatusInfo.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the toJson() method produces the expected JSON structure.

methods.name: fromValidJsonString
methods.description: Verifies that a JSON string can be correctly deserialized into a StatusInfo object.

methods.name: fromValidJsonObject
methods.description: Verifies that a JsonObject can be correctly deserialized into a StatusInfo object.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Tests setting a label on a StatusInfo object.

methods.name: labelMayBeSetToNull
methods.description: Tests that the label can be set to null.

methods.name: fromDetailReturnsStatusDownWhenItIsAnErrorDetail
methods.description: Verifies StatusInfo creation from an error detail yields Status.DOWN.

methods.name: fromDetailReturnsStatusUpWhenItIsAWarnDetail
methods.description: Verifies StatusInfo creation from a warning detail yields Status.UP.

methods.name: fromDetailReturnsStatusUpWhenItIsAnInfoDetail
methods.description: Verifies StatusInfo creation from an info detail yields Status.UP.

methods.name: fromDetailsReturnsStatusDownWhenThereIsAtLeastOneErrorDetail
methods.description: Verifies that multiple details including an error result in Status.DOWN.

methods.name: fromDetailsReturnsStatusUpWhenThereIsNoErrorDetail
methods.description: Verifies that details without errors result in Status.UP.

methods.name: fromStatusCorrectlyMapsStatus
methods.description: Verifies that fromStatus() correctly maps a Status parameter.

methods.name: fromStatusWithMessageReturnsStatusUpWithInfoDetailWhenStatusIsUp
methods.description: Verifies that fromStatus(Status.UP, message) creates appropriate StatusInfo.

methods.name: fromStatusWithMessageReturnsStatusDownWithErrorDetailWhenStatusIsDown
methods.description: Verifies that fromStatus(Status.DOWN, message) creates appropriate StatusInfo.

methods.name: fromStatusWithMessageReturnsStatusUnknownWithInfoDetailWhenStatusIsUnknown
methods.description: Verifies that fromStatus(Status.UNKNOWN, message) creates appropriate StatusInfo.

methods.name: unknownStatusReturnsStatusUnknown
methods.description: Verifies that StatusInfo.unknown() returns a StatusInfo with Status.UNKNOWN.

methods.name: compositeReturnsStatusUpWhenAllChildrenAreUp
methods.description: Verifies the composite pattern results in Status.UP when all children are UP.

methods.name: compositeReturnsStatusUpWhenChildrenAreEmpty
methods.description: Verifies that an empty children map results in Status.UP.

methods.name: compositeReturnsStatusUpWhenAllChildrenAreUpAndOneIsUnknown
methods.description: Checks composite status when some children are UP and others are UNKNOWN.

methods.name: compositeReturnsStatusDownWhenAtLeastOneChildIsDown
methods.description: Verifies composite status is DOWN if any child is DOWN.

methods.name: mergeStatus
methods.description: Tests the mergeWith logic for combining two statuses.
